reason: A client-side DSH WebUI theme plugin providing three Evangelion-inspired color schemes, embedded backdrops, decorative interface effects, and a sidebar theme switcher.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 提供三种可切换的 EVA 风格主题、嵌入式背景图、机甲界面效果和侧边栏主题切换器。
summaries.en: Provides three switchable Evangelion-inspired themes for DSH WebUI with embedded backgrounds, mecha-style interface effects, and a sidebar theme switcher.

capabilities: Modifies Web UI styling tokens and decorative overlays
Adds a sidebar theme switcher with embedded artwork
Reasserts a supported theme when the active theme changes
